svg.text: KV cache: K per layer and head [block][i][t % 16],
Header (4 KB): config, section offsets, matrix table
Matrices in qmv DDR format: per layer wq wk wv wo w1 w2 w3, then the classifier
The image is stored on the microSD card and copied to DDR3 offset 0
at power-on; host/image_tool.py uploads it over the UART.
